packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates after a 3-day cooldown (supply-chain safety)
Gradle 9 embeds Groovy 4; keep Spock on the -groovy-4.0 variant
Test fixtures reference DepClean's own SNAPSHOT artifacts from mavenLocal; never touch them

IT/FT fixtures are golden test data: their dependency versions and jar sizes are hard-coded in DepCleanMojoIT.java, DepCleanGradleFT.groovy, expectedOutputFile.txt and pom-debloated.xml goldens. Renovate cannot update those goldens (it cannot compute the jar sizes they assert), so a bump here always breaks CI. Never touch fixture dependencies; bump them manually together with their goldens.

basic_spring_maven_project fixtures feed golden trees: MavenInvokerTest diffs `mvn dependency:tree` output against tree_expected.txt, which hard-codes every transitive version resolved from the spring-boot parent. Renovate bumps of spring-boot-starter-parent here always desync the golden (see #503, needed a manual golden regeneration). Update manually together with the tree golden.
Security fix PRs get top priority

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the cooldown and get merged immediately
